## Overview Add an opt-in DoSA indexer for DSA prefill on SM100. It scores a seed subset, screens keys with score bounds, and refines the surviving candidates. Depends on #64749. This PR contains the DoSA operator and serving integration; the shared fixes are reviewed separately in that prerequisite PR. ## Claims - Supports 32/64 index heads with FP8 index keys on SM100 and CUDA 13. - At near-1M context, GLM-5.2 TTFT improves by **2.40× with Q16K** and **2.45× with Q32K**. Previously published DeepSeek-V3.2 results reach **1.83×**. ## Validation Rebased onto upstream `8a2a5e4c40f9`. GLM-5.2 was remeasured across all six contexts with both stock and DoSA on the same eight SM100 GPUs, client host, NICs and communication settings. All 96 requests completed successfully. TTFT uses SQLite 3.53.4 source prefixes, FP8 KV and TP8/EP8. Each speedup is stock / DoSA, using the median of three formal requests after one warmup. Requests use fresh IDs, a prefix-cache reset, a two-token output budget and default EOS. Here 1K = 1024 tokens. | Context | GLM Q16K | GLM Q32K | DeepSeek Q16K | DeepSeek Q32K | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | 128K | 1.0076× | 1.0035× | 0.93× | 0.88× | | 256K | 1.1238× | 1.1166× | — | — | | 384K | 1.2155× | 1.2168× | 0.97× | 0.97× | | 512K | 1.3668× | 1.3762× | 1.02× | 1.02× | | 768K | 1.8033× | 1.8235× | 1.33× | 1.35× | | ~1M | 2.3992× | 2.4463× | 1.80× | 1.83× | DeepSeek rows retain the previously published latency measurements. Requests above its 163840-token context use a 1048576-token server limit for extrapolation. These source prefixes measure latency, not independent agent tasks.
Near-1M TTFT in seconds: median [min, max] | Model | Chunk | Stock | DoSA | Speedup | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | GLM-5.2 | 16K | 188.954 [188.594, 188.963] | 78.758 [78.722, 78.768] | 2.40× | | GLM-5.2 | 32K | 189.598 [189.459, 189.631] | 77.505 [77.466, 77.512] | 2.45× | | DeepSeek-V3.2 (published) | 16K | 538.713 [538.525, 539.122] | 299.713 [299.518, 299.868] | 1.80× | | DeepSeek-V3.2 (published) | 32K | 540.997 [539.089, 541.948] | 295.277 [295.253, 295.830] | 1.83× |
The published evaluation on our fixed 100-request LongBench-v2 subset reports GLM-5.2 **54% with stock → 58% with DoSA (+4 percentage points)**. The answer differences come from choosing different valid keys at equal indexer scores. The [LongBench-v2 evaluation guide](https://github.com/llm-sys/dosa-vllm/blob/33f5da8eabdd8f77a1733ab322312f7a4653e23e/docs/features/dosa_longbench_v2.md) provides the cohort, protocol, A/A control and reproduction commands. The rebased stack passes 107 focused tests, including all 10 retained DoSA GPU cases covering H32/H64 native scoring, capacity recovery, cross-stream reuse, strided output and packed batch/fallback, plus the affected upstream SM100 GLM projection and graph paths. Re-run commands: ```bash .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/kernels/attention/test_dosa.py .venv/bin/pre-commit run --from-ref df80a82c2492c94e650a8ae6725ebbf17463ba11 --to-ref HEAD ``` ## Details Enable with `--attention-config '{"indexer_dosa": true}'`. The existing indexer remains the default. Scratch and private graphs are owned and accounted for by the workspace manager; selection state is local to each invocation. Capacity and numerical admission failures use exhaustive recovery. Shared RoPE cache-capacity, manual-fusion budget/range and worker-startup fixes are submitted separately in #64749. Both benchmark arms include these fixes. The [DoSA-only diff](https://github.com/llm-sys/dosa-vllm/compare/dsa-shared-fixes...dosa-main) contains **5,894 changed lines across 24 files**. The prerequisite contains 226 changed lines; the combined stack is 2,782 changed lines smaller than the original PR. Once #64749 merges, this PR will be rebased onto `main` to retain only the DoSA feature commit. Related PRs [#60618](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60618) and [#48726](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48726) fuse scoring and selection. DoSA adds a seed threshold and certified screening before sparse refinement; the existing dense scorer and TopK remain available for fallback. [Complete TTFT reproduction: installation, inputs, servers and client](https://github.com/llm-sys/dosa-vllm/blob/24cf7e1669234334e8f16fdd83744e2d9fb562d8/docs/features/dosa.md#ttft-reproduction). ---

+# DoSA sparse indexer
+
+DoSA accelerates DSA prefill by scoring a seed subset, screening keys with score
+bounds and refining survivors. Enable with
+`--attention-config '{"indexer_dosa":true}'`.
+
+The optimized path supports SM100, CUDA 13, FP8 index keys, 32/64 index heads,
+head dimension 128, top-k 2048 and gathered contexts of 131072–1048576 keys.
+Decode, short query/key spans, MXFP4, context parallelism, speculative decoding
+and candidate-block selection use the existing backend. The feature is disabled
+by default.
+
+Selection uses native SM100 MX/BF16 scoring. Capacity and numerical admission
+failures recover exhaustively; equal-score ties may choose different valid IDs.
+The workspace manager owns scratch and private graphs before KV-cache sizing.
+Bootstrap and carry state belong to one invocation.
+
+GLM-5.2 TTFT uses SQLite 3.53.4 prefixes, eight SM100 GPUs, FP8 KV and TP8/EP8.
+Each cell is the median of 3 formal runs after 1 warmup. Both arms run on the
+same eight GPUs with the same client and communication settings. Here 1K = 1024 tokens.
+
+| Context | Q16K stock / DoSA (s) | Speedup | Q32K stock / DoSA (s) | Speedup |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| 128K | 6.168 / 6.121 | 1.0076× | 6.059 / 6.038 | 1.0035× |
+| 256K | 15.386 / 13.691 | 1.1238× | 15.044 / 13.474 | 1.1166× |
+| 384K | 26.996 / 22.209 | 1.2155× | 26.514 / 21.790 | 1.2168× |
+| 512K | 43.317 / 31.692 | 1.3668× | 42.752 / 31.066 | 1.3762× |
+| 768K | 96.243 / 53.371 | 1.8033× | 95.704 / 52.484 | 1.8235× |
+| ~1M (1048448) | 188.954 / 78.758 | 2.3992× | 189.598 / 77.505 | 2.4463× |
+
+The [published LongBench-v2 reproduction](https://github.com/llm-sys/dosa-vllm/blob/33f5da8eabdd8f77a1733ab322312f7a4653e23e/docs/features/dosa_longbench_v2.md)
+reports stock 54/100, DoSA 58/100 and stock A/A 55/100 on 100 fixed requests.
+[Earlier DeepSeek TTFT results](https://github.com/llm-sys/dosa-vllm/blob/33f5da8eabdd8f77a1733ab322312f7a4653e23e/docs/features/dosa.md#measured-results)
+
+## TTFT reproduction
+
+Use CUDA 13, PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130 and FlashInfer 0.7.2.post1 on two four-GPU nodes.
+Use the shared-fixes prerequisite for stock and this feature revision for DoSA.
+On the feature revision, install the matching core and build the extension:
+
+```bash
+uv venv --python 3.12
+source .venv/bin/activate
+VLLM_USE_PRECOMPILED=1 VLLM_PRECOMPILED_WHEEL_VARIANT=cu130 \
+    uv pip install -e . --torch-backend=cu130
+uv pip install -r requirements/build/cuda.txt --torch-backend=cu130
+uv run --active --no-sync python tools/generate_cmake_presets.py --force-overwrite
+cmake --preset release
+cmake --build --preset release --target _dosa_C --parallel 8
+cmake --install cmake-build-release --component _dosa_C
+```
+
+Download the existing reproduction tools and generate the inputs:
+
+```bash
+export DOSA_TTFT_TOOLS=results/dosa-ttft-tools
+mkdir -p "$DOSA_TTFT_TOOLS"
+for file in prepare_inputs.py ttft_client.py; do
+    curl -fL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/llm-sys/dosa-vllm/33f5da8eabdd8f77a1733ab322312f7a4653e23e/benchmarks/dosa/$file" -o "$DOSA_TTFT_TOOLS/$file"
+done
+uv run --active --no-sync python "$DOSA_TTFT_TOOLS/prepare_inputs.py" --output-dir inputs/dosa
+```
+
+On nodes 0/1, set `NODE_RANK=0`/`NODE_RANK=1` and run the following:
+
+```bash
+export MODEL_DIR=/path/to/GLM-5.2-FP8
+export MASTER_ADDR=NODE0_IP CHUNK=32768 DOSA=false
+export NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=DATA_NIC_0,DATA_NIC_1
+export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1
+export NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0 VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER=0
+export VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM=0
+unset VLLM_USE_NCCL_SYMM_MEM
+NODE_ARGS=()
+if [ "$NODE_RANK" = 1 ]; then NODE_ARGS=(--headless); fi
+DOSA_ARGS=()
+if [ "$DOSA" = true ]; then
+    DOSA_ARGS=(--attention-config '{"indexer_dosa":true}')
+fi
+uv run --active --no-sync vllm serve "$MODEL_DIR" \
+    --served-model-name dosa-benchmark --tensor-parallel-size 8 --enable-expert-parallel \
+    --nnodes 2 --node-rank "$NODE_RANK" --master-addr "$MASTER_ADDR" --master-port 29810 \
+    --distributed-executor-backend mp --max-model-len 1048576 \
+    --max-num-batched-tokens "$CHUNK" --max-num-seqs 1 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
+    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --seed 233767787 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30210 \
+    --compilation-config '{"pass_config":{"fi_allreduce_fusion_max_size_mb":0}}' \
+    "${DOSA_ARGS[@]}" "${NODE_ARGS[@]}"
+```
+
+Use the same client host for both arms. Run against the stock server:
+
+```bash
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" uv run --active --no-sync python \
+    "$DOSA_TTFT_TOOLS/ttft_client.py" \
+    --requests inputs/dosa/glm/requests.json \
+    --base-url "http://$MASTER_ADDR:30210" --model dosa-benchmark \
+    --arm stock --source "$(git describe --always --dirty)" --output "results/glm-stock-$CHUNK"
+```
+
+Restart both servers with `DOSA=true`, then repeat with `--arm dosa` and a new
+output directory. Run both `CHUNK=16384` and `32768` on the same node pair.
+
+The client uses fresh RIDs, prefix resets, temperature 0, a two-token budget and

+MIN_KEYS = 131072

+def _candidate_page_budget(rows: int, keys: int) -> int:
+    # Bound the shared128-ID pool from the causal visibility geometry.
+    causal = (rows // 4) * ((keys - SEED + 2 * (rows - 1) + 127) // 128 + 4)
+    return max(256 * rows, causal)
+
+
+def _query_slab_rows(rows: int, keys: int) -> int:
+    """Bound physical Q slabs by the fixed per-row record and candidate budget."""
+    rows = min(triton.cdiv(rows, 8) * 8, 16384)
+    page_bytes = (128 + 2 + 2) * 4
+    budget = rows * (65536 * 5 + 256 * page_bytes)
+    while (
+        rows > 8
+        and rows * RECORD_CAPACITY * 5 + _candidate_page_budget(rows, keys) * page_bytes
+        > budget
+    ):
+        rows = max(8, rows // 16 * 8)
+    return rows

+def _destroy_stream(runtime, raw, device: torch.device):
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device.index):
+        runtime.cudaStreamDestroy(raw)

+class _Graph(torch.cuda.CUDAGraph):
+    capture_stream = None
+    # Python reset rearms retained resources; finalization only resets native nodes.
+    _native_reset = torch._C._CUDAGraph.reset
+
+    def __del__(self):
+        # Reset native nodes before releasing the unpooled capture stream.
+        stream = self.capture_stream
+        try:
+            super().__del__()
+        finally:
+            self._native_reset()
+            _ = stream

+    """Use an unpooled stream so graph reset cannot clear another BLAS cache."""
+    from cuda.bindings import runtime

+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device.index):
+        status, raw = runtime.cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(runtime.cudaStreamNonBlocking)
+        if status != runtime.cudaError_t.cudaSuccess:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"CUDA capture stream creation failed: {status}")
+        stream = torch.cuda.ExternalStream(int(raw), device=device)
+    cleanup = weakref.finalize(stream, _destroy_stream, runtime, raw, device)
+    object.__setattr__(cleanup, "atexit", False)
+    caller = torch.cuda.current_stream(device)
+    stream.wait_stream(caller)
+    graph = _Graph(keep_graph=keep_graph)
+    graph.capture_stream = stream
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize(device)
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        graph.capture_begin(capture_error_mode="global")
+        try:
+            yield graph
+        finally:
+            graph.capture_end()
+    caller.wait_stream(stream)

+    Stream-ordered children share scratch and publish permuted K IDs. Invalid

+    """

+    def __init__(self, owner: "DoSAWorkspace") -> None:

+    """Fixed-capacity scratch for one serialized WorkspaceManager execution slot.
+

+    slabs repeat the last active query in padding, without output or carry votes.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, device: torch.device, *, max_queries: int, max_keys: int, heads: int
+    ) -> None:

+                "DoSA requires H32/H64, positive Q capacity and K12288..2**20"
+            )
+        import vllm._dosa_C  # noqa: F401
+
+        self.device = torch.device(device)
+        if self.device.index is None:
+            self.device = torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
